limitations: UIUC sample is exact as published by UIUC, not certified pointwise original experimental manufacturing geometry.
Flap is open with a finite endpoint gap. No endpoint has been added, averaged, extended or sharpened.
Current sharp-trailing-edge solver rejects the exact flap; preset is for exact geometry preview/import until blunt-TE support or an explicitly named approximation is implemented.
Workshop CAD is a distinct spline representation with finite base lines and inconsistent exported unit labels; no CAD-to-DAT equivalence or conversion is claimed.
BANC acoustic 30P30N slat variants have modified trailing-edge thickness and must not be substituted silently.
